manifest.name: dsh-llm-extra-retry
manifest.description: Extra model-request recovery for the DeepSeek Harness: retries a failed model request once after a fixed delay when the provider classifies the failure as PI_AI_ERROR (unrecognized upstream error text). All other error codes stay on the built-in dsh-llm-retry default policy (5 bounded exponential-backoff retries). Composes safely with @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry via the agent/request-error waterfall using its own policyKey bookkeeping.

bundle.text:
# The dsh-llm-extra-retry bundle patch: one extra recovery listener on the
# agent/request-error waterfall that handles ONLY the `PI_AI_ERROR` failure
# code (dsh-llm-retry's fallback classification for unrecognized upstream
# error text, which the built-in default policy does not retry).
#
# Loader rules (see dsh-web-search-openai/cordis.patch.yml for the full list):
#   * Insert ONLY row ids that no earlier layer creates. `llm-extra-retry`
#     is new; do not re-insert ids owned by @deepseek-ai/dsh-base.

- insert:
    - id: llm-extra-retry
      name: dsh-llm-extra-retry

readme.text:
给 DSH 模型请求失败瀑布(`agent/request-error`)追加一条独立恢复策略:
当提供方把失败归类为 `PI_AI_ERROR`(`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 对无法识别的上游错误
文本的兜底错误码,内建默认重试策略不覆盖)时,**等待 20 秒后自动重试一次**。

其他错误码一律通过 `next()` 放行,完全保持 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`
默认策略(5 次有界指数退避 0.5s→10s、10% jitter)的行为;两者通过各自的
policyKey 独立记账,互不干扰。请求取消或插件卸载会立刻中止等待中的退避。

readme.section: 安装(已在 `profiles/web` profile 中接线)
